readiness.hed: Fredericksburg sees scattered showers turn the afternoon cloudy and cooler through tonight, clears to a sunny but much colder Tuesday near 54 with a low around 29, then climbs back to the mid-50s Wednesday before rain returns Wednesday night ahead of a wet Thanksgiving
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service shows no active watches or warnings for Fredericksburg this afternoon. Scattered rain showers move through under cloudy skies today, with temperatures falling from a high near 73 toward the mid-60s by evening, and showers continuing a chance before midnight tonight as the low drops to around 37. A cold front then drops temperatures sharply for Tuesday — sunny with a high near 54 and an overnight low around 29, the week's coldest night so far — before a milder, partly sunny Wednesday near 56 gives way to an 80 percent chance of rain Wednesday night as a wetter pattern builds in. NWS's extended outlook continues to point toward rain lingering into Thanksgiving Thursday.
actions: Tuesday night's low near 29 is the week's hardest freeze yet — bring in sensitive plants, cover outdoor spigots, and check on elderly neighbors before then.
Scattered showers are possible into this evening and before midnight tonight — give the evening commute extra following distance on wet roads.
Wednesday night's rain arriving ahead of Thanksgiving means outdoor travel prep, grocery runs, and any yard work are best finished by Wednesday afternoon.
With rain likely continuing into Thanksgiving Day itself, plan any outdoor gathering elements — parking, decorations, a turkey fryer — with a wet-weather backup.
